answer: An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The oasis schedule is applied in vault and kernel makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4313 identities would post 953 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
